dialogue.content: こんにちは本日は宜しくお願いしますお時間になりましたらスタートしますね
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for being here today. We'll get started when it's time.

dialogue.content: こんにちはこちらこそ宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: こんにちは　相談者です宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the client. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: こんにちはよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, it's a pleasure to meet you, too.

dialogue.content: 始めに、年齢と性別を教えて下さい
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 15歳　男性です
dialogue.English: I'm 15 years old, male.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます今、何年生ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What grade are you in now?

dialogue.content: 高校1年です
dialogue.English: I'm a first-year in high school.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 高校生活が始まったんですけど、楽しくなくてあまり学校に行きたくありません
dialogue.English: High school has started, but I'm not enjoying it and I don't really want to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね楽しくないというのはどんなことに関して楽しくないと感じますか？
dialogue.English: I see. When you say it's not fun, what about it do you find unenjoyable?

dialogue.content: 授業もつまらないし、クラスメイトとも仲良くなれなくて、、
dialogue.English: The classes are boring, and I can't seem to get along with my classmates...

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそれは寂しいですよね新しくスタートした学校生活、楽しく過ごしたいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. That must feel lonely. You'd like to enjoy your new school life, right?

dialogue.content: はい一応、楽しみではあったんですけどなんかつまらないなーと思って
dialogue.English: Yes. I was kind of looking forward to it, but somehow it just feels dull.

dialogue.content: つまらないなという感じなんですね授業は全てつまらないと感じますか？
dialogue.English: So you're feeling that it's boring. Do you find all of your classes boring?

dialogue.content: そうですね、もともと勉強が好きなタイプじゃないので
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm not really the type who likes studying to begin with.

dialogue.content: うんうん勉強はあまり好きではないのですねスポーツや音楽や美術などはどうですか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. So you don't really like studying. What about things like sports, music, or art?

dialogue.content: うーんそのへんの授業もあまり楽しくはないですね
dialogue.English: Hmm, those classes aren't very fun either.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね楽しくないなと思うのはなぜだと思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Why do you think you find them unenjoyable?

dialogue.content: 一応始まったばかりだから行ってますけど早く卒業したいです
dialogue.English: I'm going for now since it just started, but I want to graduate as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: 多分学校自体が好きじゃないんだと思います
dialogue.English: I think I just don't like school itself.

dialogue.content: なるほど学校そのものにあまり興味がない、という感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, it feels like you're not very interested in school itself?

dialogue.content: そうですね別に目標とかもないし仲良くしたい人も居ないですし
dialogue.English: That's right. I don't have any particular goals, and there's no one I want to be friends with.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね今の高校は卒業しようと思っていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you plan on graduating from your current high school?

dialogue.content: はい最低でも高校は卒業しないとやばいかなと思うので
dialogue.English: Yes, because I feel like I have to at least graduate from high school, or I'll be in trouble.

dialogue.content: うんうん　そうですよね中学や小学校は好きでしたか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that makes sense. Did you like middle school or elementary school?

dialogue.content: 中学までは毎日楽しかったです休みの日は中学の友達と遊んでます
dialogue.English: I had fun every day up until middle school. On my days off, I hang out with my friends from middle school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね中学までは楽しかったんですね中学のお友達との縁が続いているのは素敵ですね
dialogue.English: I see, so it was fun for you up through middle school. It's wonderful that you're still in touch with your friends from middle school.

dialogue.content: 中学の友達はほんと仲良いです
dialogue.English: I'm really close with my middle school friends.

dialogue.content: うんうん　きっと本当に気の合う、いいお友達なのでしょうね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, they must be friends you truly click with.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 高校卒業後は、どんなイメージをしていますか？
dialogue.English: What do you imagine for yourself after you graduate from high school?

dialogue.content: よく分からないです高校生活がこれから3年続くのがきついです
dialogue.English: I'm not really sure. The idea of high school continuing for the next three years feels tough.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね今は、今の生活を乗り切るのが辛いなというお気持ちなのですね？
dialogue.English: I see. So right now, it feels hard just to get through your current daily life, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい明日からも憂鬱です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm dreading tomorrow and beyond.

dialogue.content: そうですよね憂鬱になってしまいますよねここまでのお話しを少し整理してみますね
dialogue.English: That's understandable. It can make you feel down. Let me summarize what we've discussed so far.

dialogue.content: 分かりました
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 高校に入学したが、学校が楽しくなく、親しい友達もできないでも中学の頃の友達とは今でも仲良くできている高校は卒業しようとは思っているけど、それまでの三年間の生活が憂鬱で辛いと感じている　ということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, you've started high school, but it's not enjoyable and you haven't been able to make any close friends. However, you're still close with your friends from middle school. You intend to graduate from high school, but you feel that the three years until then will be depressing and difficult. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますまだ始まったばかりでこれから三年間、長いと感じますよね
dialogue.English: Thank you. It's only just started, so three years ahead can feel long, can't it?

dialogue.content: 三年間は長すぎます
dialogue.English: Three years is way too long.

dialogue.content: 早く卒業したいです
dialogue.English: I want to graduate as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: そうですよね日本ではスキップ制度がないので、きちんと三年間あるのがきついですよね
dialogue.English: I understand. In Japan, we don't have a system for skipping grades, so having to go for the full three years must be tough.

dialogue.content: つまらないけど、仕方ないですよね
dialogue.English: It's boring, but I guess it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: そうですね今は毎日学校には行っていますか？
dialogue.English: That's true. Are you going to school every day right now?

dialogue.content: 一応、行ってます卒業はしたいんで
dialogue.English: I'm going for now, since I do want to graduate.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね楽しくなくてもつまらなくても、ちゃんと毎日通っていることは凄いことだと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I see. Even if it's not fun or it's boring, the fact that you're attending every day is really impressive.

dialogue.content: そうですかね、、ほんとは行きたくないですけど
dialogue.English: Do you think so...? I honestly don't want to go, though.

dialogue.content: 行かなくなったら親心配すると思うんで
dialogue.English: I think my parents would worry if I stopped going.

dialogue.content: そうですよねご自分のことだけでも辛いのに、ご両親のお気持ちも心配される優しい方なのですね相談者さんにとって、「学校」とはどんなところでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I can see that. It's already tough for you, yet you're also concerned about your parents' feelings. That's very kind of you. For you, what kind of place is "school"?

dialogue.content: よく分からないです勉強するところですかね？
dialogue.English: I'm not really sure. A place to study, I guess?

dialogue.content: うんうん確かに学ぶ場ではありますよね中学の時には、学び以外に得たものはあったと思いますか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, it certainly is a place for learning. In middle school, do you think you gained anything besides knowledge?

dialogue.content: 良い友達が出来ました
dialogue.English: I made good friends.

dialogue.content: そうですね今でも仲良くできる親友を得られましたよね部活や委員会などはどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: That's right. You gained close friends that you still get along with. What about clubs or committees?

dialogue.content: うーん楽しかったですけどなにが得られたかは分からないです
dialogue.English: Hmm, they were fun, but I'm not sure what I gained from them.

dialogue.content: うんうん今は部活とかはしていますか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. Are you in any clubs now?

dialogue.content: 一応テニス部に入っています
dialogue.English: I'm in the tennis club, for now.

dialogue.content: テニスをしているんですね部活は楽しいですか？
dialogue.English: So you play tennis. Is the club fun?

dialogue.content: 今のところはあまり楽しくないです
dialogue.English: So far, it's not very fun.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね三年間は本当に長いと思います今の学校に通うこと自体があまりに辛いようであれば、ご両親とお話しをして、例えば通信制の高校に通うという手もあるかもしれませんが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Three years can feel very long. If attending your current school itself becomes too difficult, you could talk with your parents about options like enrolling in a correspondence high school. How would you feel about that?

dialogue.content: 出来ればいまのところで頑張っていきたいと思ってます
dialogue.English: If possible, I’d like to try to stick it out where I am now.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねその考えも素晴らしいですねでは、どのようにすれば少しでも憂鬱さが軽減できると思いますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That's a wonderful way of thinking as well. In that case, what do you think might help to lessen these gloomy feelings, even a little?

dialogue.content: まだ始まったばかりなので時間が経てばなにか楽しくなるかもしれないです
dialogue.English: Since it has only just started, maybe it will get fun over time.

dialogue.content: うんうんとても前向きでいい考え方ですよね相談者さんは15歳で、これからの可能性は無限大だと思います
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, that's a very positive and good way to think. You're 15, and I believe your future possibilities are endless.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: これからの三年間の間にも、思ってもみなかったようないい先生と出会えたり、良い友達と出会えたりするかもしれないと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Over the next three years, you might meet great teachers or good friends you hadn't expected. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: そうですねこれから時間が経てば友達も出来るかもしれないです
dialogue.English: Yeah, as time goes by, I might make friends, too.

dialogue.content: そうですよねあとは、高校性になれば、学校によってはバイトが許可されている学校もあるので、全く違った環境や全く世代の人達と触れ合う時間ができると、またあらたな発見や楽しさができるかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: That's right. Also, now that you're in high school, some schools allow part-time jobs. If you have the chance to interact with people in a completely different environment and of different generations, you might make new discoveries and find new sources of fun.

dialogue.content: 確かにそうかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: That might be true.

dialogue.content: うんうん　ぜひ「高校」という枠にとらわれず、何にでもチャレンジしてみて下さいきっと大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. Please don't feel confined to the 'high school' box—try challenging yourself with anything. I'm sure you'll be okay.

dialogue.content: 分かりました
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: では終了のお時間となりましたので本日はここまでとなります
dialogue.English: Well, our time is up, so we'll end here for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: (相談者役、お疲れ様でした)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your work playing the client.)

dialogue.content: (カウンセラー役お疲れ様でした。また機会がありましたら宜しくお願い致します。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your work playing the counselor. I look forward to the opportunity to work with you again.)
